derivations.backend_tests_collected: Count of pytest node IDs collected from backend/tests/ via scripts/backend_test_partitions.py's collect_exhaustive() (pytest --collect-only, fail-closed on any exit code other than 0/5).
derivations.backend_test_files: Count of distinct file paths among those collected node IDs (not every *.py under backend/tests/).
derivations.frontend_vitest_tests: Count of tests printed by `vitest list` (frontend/, pinned project config).
derivations.api_operations: Count of get/post/put/patch/delete/options/head/trace keys across 'paths' in sdk/openapi.json.
derivations.python_runtime_shipped: Major.minor version parsed from the 'FROM python:X.Y...' line in Dockerfile.backend.
